ctaHeading: Ready to transform your Preston garden?
aboutText: Cuttin' Hedge Gardening is a small family-run business based in Preston, VIC, with a passion for native flora and sustainable practices. We bring qualified horticultural expertise to create beautiful, low-maintenance gardens that you can enjoy with the whole family. Serving Preston and surrounds, we aim to deliver exceptional gardening services tailored to your needs.
servicesSubheading: Expert care for your Preston garden
servicesText: We offer a comprehensive range of gardening services, from bespoke garden design to efficient irrigation systems. Specialising in native flora, we create sustainable outdoor spaces that are both beautiful and easy to maintain for Preston homeowners.
